veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'maar' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb (dit voel / voel jy).
AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences (ons noem / hulle dra); the protected 'gewerwelde diere' stays intact.

veranderings.voor: op te hou en vorm te gee
veranderings.na: op te hou en dit vorm te gee
veranderings.rede: 'vorm gee' needs an object (iets vorm gee); 'die lyf' is the object of 'ophou' only, so 'dit' completes the second verb.
The sentence states a general truth in the present; past-tense 'kon' reads as if it were about one past event.
AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects and verbs (brein en hart is / stamp kan).

veranderings.voor: Die skedel is by die meeste gewerwelde diere byna heeltemal om die brein toe
veranderings.na: Die skedel sit by die meeste gewerwelde diere byna heeltemal om die brein
veranderings.rede: 'is ... om die brein toe' is a stiff construction; 'sit ... om die brein' is natural, and both protected phrases stay word for word.
AWS comma between two adjectives of equal rank (dun en sag).
Same AWS comma between equal adjectives, so the glossary matches the study text.

veranderings.blok: Die ribbes om die hart en die longe
veranderings.voor: Die ribbes is lang dun bene
veranderings.na: Die ribbes is lang, dun bene
veranderings.rede: AWS comma between two adjectives of equal rank (lank en dun).
AWS comma: 'want' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
AWS comma between two adjectives of equal rank (lank en sterk).

veranderings.voor: By die agterste ledemate sit by baie diere
veranderings.na: By baie diere sit daar by die agterste ledemate
veranderings.rede: The two 'by' phrases with different senses jammed around the verb read clumsily; leading with 'By baie diere' flows better, and the protected heupbene wording stays intact.
The sentence switches from ''n Mens' to 'jou geraamte'; 'Jy' keeps the reference consistent and also avoids reading ''n mens' as the generic 'one'.
AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects and verbs.
AWS comma: 'en tog' joins two sentences (slang het / het hy).

veranderings.voor: Die stewige deel waar 'n hele paar ribbes van albei kante by baie diere bymekaar kom, oorkant die ruggraat.
veranderings.na: Die stewige deel oorkant die ruggraat waar by baie diere 'n hele paar ribbes van albei kante bymekaar kom.
veranderings.rede: The trailing ', oorkant die ruggraat' dangles and 'by baie diere' interrupts the clause; reordering keeps every word and qualifier ('n hele paar, baie) but reads cleanly.

vlae.teks: Die derde taak is om die dier te laat beweeg.
vlae.rede: 'laat beweeg' says the skeleton makes the animal move; 'help beweeg' may be what is meant (muscles move the bones), but that is a meaning question, so it is flagged rather than changed.

vlae.teks: Lang dun bene wat soos boë om die bors buig.
vlae.rede: If the comma in 'lang, dun bene' is kept in the study text, the glossary should match; this line cannot be targeted on its own because the same words occur in the study text, so it needs the writer.
